Fix round 2 for #3279: rewrote the Ownership paragraph's viewer/grant sentences. Checked against secret-binding-administration.ts: FileSecretBindingAdministration.grant throws SecretBindingPersonGrantError for any person-owned binding (both mcp-integration-env and acp-provider-header) after requiredActiveBinding's not-found/visibility check; SecretBindingIntegrationService.bindInternal no longer takes the already-granted shortcut for a person-owned binding; getIntegrationBindings returns def.secretEnvRefs unfiltered; create refuses a used id regardless of owner. secret-bindings.ts maps the person-grant error to 400 with SECRET_BINDING_PERSON_GRANT_MESSAGE. mcp-secret-child-env.ts passes no principalId to resolveForIntegration, which is why shared children cannot use a person's binding. Executed: connected-accounts.e2e.test.ts (owner grant to a stdio env and an ACP header -> fixed 400, binding and integration refs unchanged; Bob's get/replace/revoke/bind/unbind/ACP bind/unbind on Alice's binding byte-identical to a missing id; instance binding binds; every caller sees every reference) and secret-binding-administration.test.ts. Limits: references to person-owned bindings written before this refusal (only by this branch's earlier revision or a hand edit) are listed, can be unbound by their owner, but return 404 to anyone else's unbind.
